subject: Dashboards not loading - board meeting at 3pm
body:
Hi team,

Since about 9:40 this morning none of our Northwind dashboards load. Every chart shows "Data source timeout" and the whole finance team is blocked. We have our quarterly board meeting at 3pm today and the revenue deck is built on these dashboards.

Can someone look at this right away and tell me if there is a workaround in the meantime?

Thanks,
Dana Whitfield
Head of Finance Operations, BigClient

subject: Pricing for 40 seats + SSO?
body:
Hello,

I'm Head of Data at FreshCart (online grocery, ~300 employees). We're evaluating analytics platforms to replace our current BI tool before our contract renews on 31 October.

Could you send pricing for roughly 40 seats, and confirm whether SSO (Okta) and a Snowflake connector are included in the Business plan? If it looks like a fit, I'd like to book a demo for my team next week.

Best regards,
Marco Rossi

subject: CSV export cuts off at 10,000 rows
body:
Hi support,

When I export the "Monthly Orders" report to CSV, the file always stops at exactly 10,000 rows even though the report has about 14,500. Excel export works fine, so I can use that for now, but our ETL job expects CSV.

Is this a limit on our plan or a bug? Workspace ID: lumen-analytics-02.

Thanks!
Priya

subject: Q4 partnership review - finding a time
body:
Hi Alex,

It's time for our quarterly partnership review. Would any of these work for a 45-minute video call?

- Tuesday 6 Oct, 14:00 CET
- Wednesday 7 Oct, 10:00 CET
- Thursday 8 Oct, 16:00 CET

I'd like to cover the co-marketing results and the integration roadmap.

Best,
Julia

subject: Thanks for speaking at the Analytics Meetup
body:
Hi Northwind team,

Just a quick note to say thank you for the talk on self-serve dashboards last Thursday. We had 85 attendees and the feedback forms were very positive. The recording is now online on our meetup page.

No action needed, just wanted to pass on the thanks!

Cheers,
Sam
